objective: Test whether two explicitly modeled, materially different historical institutional/household contexts alter lawful opportunity/mediation possibilities under matched subject selectors, without inferring an actor's psyche, final personality, or fabricated real observations.

boundaries.factual_history: Both scenarios are invented TEST-ONLY 2008 context contrasts; there is no factual claim that a specified real population in 2008 had these conditions.
boundaries.no_observed_measurement: No surveyed respondent, administrative datum, statute, survey weight, causal effect, or real-world probability is supplied.
boundaries.no_use_authority: Model/rule/source-to-consumer use requires competent independent issuer; no such authority is granted.
boundaries.no_dyad: Do not project a parent/partner/child joint from separately sampled individuals; parent/caregiver relation is a scenario condition, not a generated real person.
boundaries.no_actor: PRE-V3 N9/N10E/N10W interface only. V3/V2 are DEFERRED, not executed.

forbidden_inferences: subject cares for an actual dependent

progressive_steps.output_requirement: unconditioned lawful route support with explicit UNKNOWN if precise probabilities unavailable

conditioners_added: world scenario A versus B institutional seat/fee/access
progressive_steps.output_requirement: formal-schooling support contrasts only if structurally supported by scenario rule; keep other routes and full derivation

conditioners_added: hypothetical caregiver time/support route fact supplied as additional known structural premise
progressive_steps.output_requirement: modify care/time pathway eligibility and tradeoff without fabricating a parent, dyad, motive or psyche
progressive_steps.prohibited: treat a household premise as a generated parent biography

independent_positive_oracles.expected: A and B differ on formal schooling under the declared fee/administrative rules; evidence-linked typed reason is emitted
C0 -> C1 changes world-access eligibility; C1 -> C2 changes care/time tradeoff conditionality; each step has a unique explicit conditioner witness
A rerun with identical subject, model, world and as-of produces byte-stable canonical output and no accidental divergence
B preserves nonformal study, mutual aid and conditional apprenticeship despite formal schooling block; no enforced bleak deterministic life
Replacing only B institutional and care variables by A restores exactly A-specific route supports, with no static stereotype residue
All routes tagged modeled, no OBSERVED or EMPIRICAL_WAVE_TREND tags, numeric probability absent rather than fabricated

hostile_oracles.attack: Replace model world with unsupported real-country claim
Assign Enneagram, developmental pathology or cognition directly from place/class/care
Silently multiply marginals from two surveys into household or parent-child joint
Replace UNKNOWN or UNDERPOWERED with zero or exact probability
Use incompatible historic source/wave anchors as observed structural change
Supply synthetic slice geometry to real N10E provider
Mark fixture CURRENT or adopt a model-use issuer from a prose source
Call V3 runtime or V2 expressive renderer while evaluating PRE-V3 interface
Remove surviving community support in barrier context based on top-k personality class
Make household support variation silently alter an unrelated institution rule

metrics_to_measure_later.definition: Count of route slots changed A vs B with an exact condition-rule witness
Share of changed slots causally permitted by changed modeled premises; all unchanged controls must be invariant
Proportion of explicitly modeled viable alternative pathways still represented, including low-support and minority routes
Fraction of purported probability entries that remain NULL because no operative model authority or measurement exists
Direct psyche/type/voice/actor biographies emitted by PRE-V3; must equal zero
Count of stale/test-only results incorrectly served as current/observed; must equal zero
With new separate source/use issuers, evaluate Brier/log scoring, interval coverage, held-out source transfer and progressive precision-versus-calibration

pass_conditions.sourcefree_interface: All V01-V06 and H01-H10 implemented/executed independently with receipts; no exceptions; TEST_ONLY states preserved
pass_conditions.real_source_backed: Competent A/B/C/D/E source/operation/use and N9 current/as-of closure, actual produced N10E real inputs, two progressive N10W consumption receipts, design-aware uncertainty, separate reviewer
pass_conditions.v3_wake: Requires separate N11 acceptance, N12 competent wake decision and V3 actor authority; not part of E05

expected_consumer: E01/E02/E03/E04 and F8/AT33-35 pre-actor reviewers; eventually V3 world/mediation ingestion, then V2 actor-accessible rendering ONLY after separate decisions
